lesson: In find_hashtags, drop hashtags that consist entirely of digits unless they are 4-digit years (1900-2099); filtering all pure numeric tags indiscriminately was rejected.
why: The platform runs year campaigns like #2024 and #2025, making 4-digit years valid tags while other numeric tags clutter trends.
quote: drop a hashtag if it's all digits UNLESS it's a 4-digit year (1900-2099), which we keep.
